components.heading: Time limit.
components.text: All grading operations shall proceed according to a work schedule included in the grading and erosion control plan. The schedule shall provide that the soil is exposed and unprotected for the shortest possible period of time. (Ord. 16432 § 6(1), 3-10-92. Code 1995 § 66-121.)
